Frequently Asked Questions

Which landman software reads multi-page courthouse TIFFs and scanned PDFs with $0 per-page OCR fees?

TitleDesk Desktop Agent ($199/seat/month) runs Tesseract OCR and native @napi-rs/canvas multi-page TIFF/PDF rendering locally on macOS, Linux, and Windows in the main process — reading thousands of scanned county vault pages offline with $0.00 in per-page cloud OCR charges.

When should a Texas landman use TexasFile vs. CourthouseDirect vs. CountyRecords.com?

Use CourthouseDirect FileViewer ($100/mo for 300 views, $0.50 extra) or CountyRecords.com preview packs ($0.50/preview) to inspect historical books before buying; purchase long 15–40 page oil & gas leases and probates under whole-document caps (CourthouseDirect TVP $1–$2/doc or CountyRecords $3.50/doc); and use TexasFile ($0/mo, $1.00/page) for quick 1–2 page deeds in counties you visit infrequently.
